subject: Mock Presidential Speeches and Science Fair Highlights
overview: Medford High School students produced a video report featuring highlights from the school science fair and mock campaign speeches by students portraying 2016 presidential candidates.

items.title: Softball Team Sketch
items.summary: Students performed a comedy sketch based on the 'Who's on First?' routine regarding the roster of the softball team.

items.title: Science Fair: Music Tempo and Cognition
items.summary: Students presented a project finding that no music is generally more effective for cognitive tasks than music at varying speeds, though faster tempos performed better than slow ones.

items.title: Science Fair: Physics of Gymnastics
items.summary: A student explained a physics experiment determining that a back layout flip takes longer to complete than a back tuck due to increased air resistance.

items.title: Science Fair: Muon Flux Detection
items.summary: Students demonstrated a cloud chamber used to test how varying alcohol concentrations affect the detection sensitivity of cosmic ray decay particles.

items.title: Question of the Week
items.summary: The segment provided an answer to the previous week's trivia question and introduced a new question concerning unique student talents.

items.title: Mock Presidential Campaign Speeches
items.summary: Students delivered campaign-style speeches portraying various 2016 presidential candidates, including Hillary Clinton, Donald Trump, Bernie Sanders, Marco Rubio, Mike Bloomberg, John Kasich, Ted Cruz, Ben Carson, and Jeb Bush.
